text: {"alternatives": [{"component_id": "c1", "service": "Azure Container Apps", "sku": "Standard", "details": "Consumption plan with dedicated workload profile replacing the AKS control plane; scale to zero overnight; Linux, West Europe, 2 replicas during business hours", "rationale": "Removes the AKS cluster and its always-on node pool, so you pay only for running container replicas and avoid cluster management overhead while still hosting the web API.", "tradeoffs": ["Less control over Kubernetes networking and node configuration", "Migration effort for existing manifests and Helm charts", "Consumption plan cold starts when scaled to zero"], "also_replaces": ["c1", "c2"]}, {"component_id": "c3", "service": "Azure Database for PostgreSQL", "sku": "Burstable B2s", "details": "Flexible Server, 2 vCore, EU data residency in West Europe; only if the application can migrate from SQL Server dialect", "rationale": "Burstable compute suits a load that is high in business hours and low at night, typically costing far less than a provisioned 4 vCore General Purpose SQL Database.", "tradeoffs": ["Requires migrating from SQL Database to PostgreSQL, including T-SQL and schema changes", "Burstable credits can be exhausted under sustained peak load", "Fewer SQL Server-specific features available"], "also_replaces": []}, {"component_id": "c4", "service": "Redis Cache", "sku": "C2", "details": "Standard tier, 6 GB, single node or replicated; Premium features such as clustering, VNet injection and persistence not needed", "rationale": "Standard tier provides a replicated, SLA-backed cache at lower cost, sufficient for a 2,000-user workload that does not use Premium-only features.", "tradeoffs": ["No VNet injection, clustering or data persistence", "Smaller memory and throughput limits than P1", "Confirm no Premium-only features are in use before switching"], "also_replaces": []}]}
